metadata.title: Code Quality and Type Safety Enhancement

story.iWant: have zero type errors and consistent code style in a high-quality codebase
story.soThat: we can improve development efficiency and code maintainability
story.tasks: - [ ] Task 1 (AC: 1): Enable strict TypeScript mode - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Update TypeScript compiler options with strict mode enabled - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Add `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` for array/object access safety - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Add `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` for optional property precision - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Fix any immediate type errors that arise from strict mode activation - [ ] Task 2 (AC: 2): Enhance ESLint configuration - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Install and configure `@typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking` - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Add custom rules for code consistency and type safety - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Integrate ESLint with IDE and build process - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Fix all ESLint violations across the codebase - [ ] Task 3 (AC: 3): Establish Prettier standardization - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Configure Prettier with team-standard formatting rules - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Set up editor integration with VSCode and other IDEs - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Add Prettier CLI scripts for manual formatting - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Format entire codebase consistently - [ ] Task 4 (AC: 4): Add Pre-commit Hooks - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Install and configure Husky for Git hooks - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Set up lint-staged to run linting and formatting on staged files - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Configure automated tests to run before commit - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Document development workflow and standards - [ ] Task 5 (AC: 5): SonarQube/CodeClimate integration - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Set up SonarQube server or CodeClimate integration - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Configure quality gates and metrics thresholds - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Integrate with CI/CD pipeline for automated analysis - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Establish code quality trend tracking and reporting

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Enable strict TypeScript mode - `strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` 2. Enhance ESLint configuration - add `@typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking` 3. Establish Prettier standardization - unified code format, editor integration 4. Add Pre-commit Hooks - Husky + lint-staged automated checks 5. SonarQube/CodeClimate integration - code quality metrics and trend tracking

artifact.reason: Current strict mode is disabled (strict: false) - this is the primary target for AC1 implementation
Multiple type checking options are disabled (noImplicitAny, noImplicitReturns, etc.) - need to enable for comprehensive type safety
Currently only extends next/core-web-vitals - needs @typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking for AC2
TypeScript ESLint plugins already installed - need to configure recommended-requiring-type-checking ruleset
Prettier already installed - needs configuration and integration for AC3

constraints.constraint: Must enable TypeScript strict mode without breaking existing functionality
ESLint configuration must include type-checking rules for enhanced type safety
Prettier configuration must maintain consistency with Tailwind CSS formatting
Pre-commit hooks must not significantly impact developer workflow performance
Quality gates integration must work with existing GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
All changes must be backward compatible and not require major refactoring

tests.standards: Unit tests (>80%覆盖率): 策略算法计算准确性, API端点响应正确性, 数据处理逻辑完整性. Integration tests: 完整的数据获取到策略回测流程, 前后端API交互, 缓存机制有效性. End-to-end tests: 用户旅程完整性, 错误处理和恢复, 性能目标验证.

test.description: Verify TypeScript compilation with strict mode enabled
Test noUncheckedIndexedAccess catches unsafe array/object access
Validate ESLint catches type-related issues with new ruleset
Verify Prettier formatting consistency across file types
Test pre-commit hooks block malformed commits
